look: 手工毛毡玩偶定格动画风格，绒面毛毡质感，柔和高光与浅景深微距感。
setting: 角色1站在画面中央，面前的地上散落着筹码；其余角色先后从画面右侧走入，停在筹码前面，石化后留在原地不动。
scene: 桌面微缩布景：麻布台面上铺着一块暗红色地毯，地毯周围立着几盏彩色的小蘑菇灯。
light_text: 夜里的桌面微缩布景，唯一光源是布景中几盏小蘑菇灯的暖橙色柔光，光线柔和温暖，背景自然虚化。
constraints: 全片三段生成。价格刻度写在每只兔子胸前的木牌上，是剧情必需道具：角色1 $100、角色2 $50、角色3 $25、角色4 $1，价格一路往下掉。角色1开场已经抱着竹篮站在筹码前，他没有进场动作；其余三只依次从画面右侧走进。每只兔子都伸手去捡地上的筹码，等价格跌过自己那块牌子的价钱，就从爪子开始一层层变成灰色石像，保持当时的姿势、竹篮和牌子不动，留在原地成为下一段的背景，石像只会越来越多。前两段镜头平稳，最后一段角色4蹲下捡筹码之后硬切到全景（约在最后一段3秒处），镜头缓缓拉高升起，俯拍整片铺满地面的石像群像。每段第一拍安排进场动作，台词与收尾节拍必须完整落在续接重叠之后。哭喊短促不拖长气声；角色2与角色3的喊话是兴奋而不是怒斥，语速偏快；角色4那句是平静的陈述，语速慢。不出现字幕、气泡与文字；画面只出现这四只兔子与背景里成排的石像群像。
source_script:
角色1动作：角色1抱着竹篮站在那堆筹码前面，低头盯着地上的筹码，伸出一只爪子想去捡，泪水从脸上滑下来。
角色1：啊啊啊！
角色1动作：角色1的身体从爪子开始发硬，一层层变成灰色的石像，保持着伸手够筹码的姿势定在原地。
角色2入场：角色2提着一个竹篮从画面右侧走进来，径直走到那堆筹码前面。
角色2：市场血流成河，正是抄底好时机！
角色2动作：角色2蹲下身，把竹篮口贴着地面，一枚一枚把筹码拨进篮子里。
角色2动作：角色2的身体从爪子开始发硬，一层层变成灰色的石像，保持着蹲着拨筹码的姿势定在原地。
角色3入场：角色3提着一个竹篮从画面右侧走进来，在那两尊石像旁边停下。
角色3：跌到二十五了，遍地黄金！
角色3动作：角色3蹲下来，把地上的筹码一枚一枚拨进自己的竹篮。
角色3动作：角色3的身体从爪子开始发硬，一层层变成灰色的石像，保持着蹲着拨筹码的姿势定在原地。
角色4入场：角色4提着一个竹篮从画面右侧走进来，走到那排石像前面停下。
角色4：……市场血流成河，恐慌情绪蔓延。
角色4动作：角色4蹲下身，把竹篮口伸向地上仅剩的几枚筹码。
角色4动作：角色4的身体从爪子开始发硬，变成灰色石像，保持着蹲着够筹码的姿势定在原地。

execution.look: Handmade felt-puppet stop-motion style, fuzzy felt surface texture, soft highlights and a shallow-focus macro feel.
execution.setting: Character 1 stands at the center of the frame with colored chips scattered on the ground in front of it; the other characters walk in from the right one after another, stop in front of the chips, and stay where they stand after turning to stone.
execution.scene: A tabletop miniature set: a dark red rug laid over a burlap cloth surface, with a few small colorful mushroom lamps standing around it.
execution.light: A tabletop miniature set at night, lit only by the warm orange glow of small mushroom lamps inside the set; the light is soft and warm and the background falls out of focus.
execution.visible_state: Character 1 stands at the center of the frame, leaning forward with one paw stretched down toward the colored chips scattered on the ground, a woven basket and a $100 wooden price tag at the chest; every buyer carries a wooden price tag showing the price that buyer paid. Each buyer turns into a gray stone figure the moment the price falls below the tag on the chest, and each stone figure keeps the pose it was frozen in with the basket still in the paws. The chips lie on the ground between the buyers and the right edge of the frame.

directions.event_001: Character 1 stands at the center of the frame in front of the scattered chips with one woven basket in the paw, lowers the head toward the chips, reaches the other paw down toward the nearest chip, and tears run down the face; a wooden price tag reading $100 hangs at the chest.
directions.event_003: Character 1's body hardens from the paws upward into a gray stone figure, the reaching pose staying fixed, the woven basket and the $100 price tag held in place.
directions.event_004: Character 2 walks in from the right edge of the frame carrying one woven basket, passes the gray stone figure of Character 1 frozen mid-reach, and stops at the edge of the chips; a wooden price tag reading $50 hangs at the chest.
directions.event_006: Character 2 squats down, pushes the mouth of the woven basket along the ground and sweeps the scattered chips into it one by one until a small heap of chips sits inside.
directions.event_007: Character 2's body hardens from the paws upward into a gray stone figure, the squatting pose staying fixed, the loaded basket and the $50 price tag held in place.
directions.event_008: Character 3 walks in from the right carrying one woven basket, passes the two gray stone figures standing at the left frozen mid-motion, and stops beside them at the edge of the chips; a wooden price tag reading $25 hangs at the chest.
directions.event_010: Character 3 squats down next to the stone figures and sweeps the chips on the ground into the woven basket with a paw.
directions.event_011: Character 3's body hardens from the paws upward into a gray stone figure, the squatting pose staying fixed, the basket and the $25 price tag held in place.
directions.event_012: Character 4 walks in from the right carrying one woven basket, passes the row of three gray stone figures frozen along the left, and stops in front of them closest to the chips; a wooden price tag reading $1 hangs at the chest.
directions.event_014: Character 4 squats down, pushes the woven basket along the ground and gathers the last few chips into it.
directions.event_015: Character 4's body hardens from the paws upward into a gray stone figure, the squatting pose staying fixed, the basket and the $1 price tag held in place; the view then pulls back and lifts to a high overhead angle over the front row of stone figures, looking down on the whole field of petrified rabbits stretching far into the distance, many more of them than the four in front.
